name: DISPOSABLE ONLY · Derived Error Redaction Receipt

// Purpose: Upsert Durable Failure Receipt. Keep this deterministic and fail closed.
return [{ json: { ...$json, readback_verified: false } }];

// Purpose: Read Back Failure Receipt. Keep this deterministic and fail closed.
return [{ json: { ...$('Redact and Classify Failure').first().json, readback_verified: false } }];

// Purpose: Mark Failure Readback Verified. Keep this deterministic and fail closed.
return [{ json: { ...$json, readback_verified: true } }];

// Purpose: Read Back Verified Failure Receipt. Keep this deterministic and fail closed.
return [{ json: { ...$('Mark Failure Readback Verified').first().json, readback_verified: true } }];

// Purpose: Upsert OPEN Provider Circuit. Keep this deterministic and fail closed.
return [{ json: { ...$json, readback_verified: false } }];

// Purpose: Read Back OPEN Provider Circuit. Keep this deterministic and fail closed.
return [{ json: { ...$('Build OPEN Provider Circuit').first().json, readback_verified: false } }];
